review: all scenarios: A's library was empty while Reverse Engineer's expected outcome draws three cards; gave A a library of five Islands.

702.126b-1 (now 702.126a-2): the two_blue_sources variant changed two facts (Islands and Ornithopters); it now adds one Island only. The scenario shows improvise paying only generic mana, which rule 702.126a states, so it moved to 702.126a; 702.126b stays covered by the Thalia scenario.
702.126b-2: renumbered 702.126b-1 after the previous 702.126b-1 moved to 702.126a.

scenarios.title: Improvise lets untapped artifacts pay for generic mana
decisions: A casts Reverse Engineer, tapping both Islands for {U}{U} and tapping all three Ornithopters with improvise to pay the {3}.
Both players pass; Reverse Engineer resolves.

variants.label: three_artifacts
variants.expected: Casting is legal. The three Ornithopters are tapped for the generic mana and Reverse Engineer resolves: A draws three cards.

variants.label: two_artifacts
variants.delta: A controls two Ornithopters instead of three.
variants.expected: Only two of the three generic mana can be paid by improvise, and A has no other source. Casting is not legal and Reverse Engineer stays in A's hand.

variants.label: one_artifact_tapped
variants.delta: One of the three Ornithopters is tapped.
variants.expected: Only two untapped artifacts can be tapped, so the {3} cannot be paid. Casting is not legal and Reverse Engineer stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Variant one_artifact_tapped sets tapped=true on one Ornithopter in the base setup; variant two_artifacts removes one.

scenarios.title: Improvise pays only generic mana, never colored mana
decisions: A casts Reverse Engineer, tapping its Islands for blue mana and tapping Ornithopters with improvise for the generic mana.
Both players pass; Reverse Engineer resolves.

variants.label: one_blue_source
variants.expected: Improvise can pay the {3} but not the second {U}, and A has only one blue source. Casting is not legal and Reverse Engineer stays in A's hand.

variants.label: two_blue_sources
variants.delta: A controls two Islands instead of one.
variants.expected: Both Islands pay {U}{U} and three Ornithopters pay the {3}; casting is legal and Reverse Engineer resolves: A draws three cards. Two Ornithopters stay untapped.

scenarios.title: Improvise applies after cost increases are included in the total cost
decisions: A casts Reverse Engineer, tapping both Islands for {U}{U} and tapping all four Ornithopters with improvise to pay the generic mana.
Both players pass; Reverse Engineer resolves.

variants.label: four_artifacts
variants.expected: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben raises the total cost to {4}{U}{U}. The four Ornithopters pay the four generic mana, casting is legal and Reverse Engineer resolves: A draws three cards.

variants.label: three_artifacts
variants.delta: A controls three Ornithopters instead of four.
variants.expected: The total cost is {4}{U}{U} and only three generic mana can be paid by improvise. Casting is not legal and Reverse Engineer stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Variant three_artifacts removes one Ornithopter from the base setup.

scenarios.title: A spell with two instances of improvise pays each generic mana at most once

setup.notes: Reverse Engineer has printed improvise and gains a second instance from Inspiring Statuary.

decisions: A casts Reverse Engineer, tapping both Islands for {U}{U} and tapping Inspiring Statuary and both Ornithopters with improvise to pay the {3}.
Both players pass; Reverse Engineer resolves.

variants.label: three_artifacts
variants.expected: The total cost is {3}{U}{U}. The three artifacts pay the {3}, casting is legal and Reverse Engineer resolves: A draws three cards.

variants.label: two_artifacts
variants.delta: A controls one Ornithopter instead of two.
variants.expected: The second instance of improvise adds no further payment ability: only two generic mana can be paid, so casting is not legal and Reverse Engineer stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Variant two_artifacts removes one Ornithopter from the base setup.
